segments.title: The contract — primary sources only
segments.narration: This is LIRIL. What you are about to watch is not opinion journalism and not a party broadcast. It is a documentary of the public record of Canada — assembled from open government documents, Hansard, Auditor General reports, Statistics Canada, court records, royal commissions, and public social-media posts by officials and named subjects. Every major claim will land on a source. Where the record is incomplete, we say so. Where a statement is inference, we label it. The film runs for hours because the country is not a soundbite.

segments.title: How to watch a multi-hour public record
segments.narration: You can watch continuously, pause, jump by era, or open any source in a new tab. Each beat holds government documents and public social posts long enough to read. WATCH mode advances automatically. NAVIGATE mode lets you scrub acts like chapters of a book. Progress is saved in this browser so a multi-hour film can be finished over days.

segments.title: The arc — from foundation to this hour
segments.narration: The film tracks Canadian state power from Indigenous nations and first contact, through conquest and Confederation, residential schools and the Indian Act, war and welfare-state construction, the Charter, free trade, the security state after two thousand one, and the multi-axis present: procurement failure, MAID expansion, housing collapse, foreign interference findings, media capture, and social amplification. The destination is not a conspiracy. It is a timeline of open records leading to today.

segments.title: Open government + open social as one continuous feed
segments.narration: Modern accountability requires both ledgers and timelines. Federal open data, Access to Information releases already published, committee testimony, and public posts by ministers, crown corporations, unions, and named citizens form one evidence graph. TENET5's local OSINT vault freezes public fetches with timestamps. Private messages and private persons are out of scope.
